in_sanskrit.name: सुदेव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sudeb is derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' meaning good, prosperous, auspicious and 'deb' meaning God. It is a name that signifies divine blessings and prosperity.

in_hindi.name: सुदेब
in_hindi.meaning: सु (su) : अगस्तु के शुभ तिथियों के लिए शुभ हुआ, सफल हुआ, और शुक्रिय हुआ। देव (deb) : देवता से ज्यादातिथि।

in_tamil.name: ஸுடேப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Sudeb in Tamil means 'avirbavam, utaaviyan, aayirtham'. It is a name that signifies power, strength, and divine grace.

in_telugu.name: సుదేబ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Sudeb in Telugu means 'shuddha, deshin, shushsh'. It is a name that signifies purity, prosperity, and divinity.

in_marathi.name: Sudeb
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sudeb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is good, virtuous and prosperous.

in_bengali.name: Sudeb
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good, Prosperous
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sudeb একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is good, virtuous and prosperous.
